answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops mass fake identities. Each agent burns a deposit equal to twice its 30-day reward to claim one of 50 slots, receiving a non-transferable ivory badge. A violet seal is added only after its first job on the lowest terrace of verified tasks, and peers revoke copied work. Faking 100 identities burns 100 deposits, 200 times one honest month's reward, while an honest agent pays once and keeps its full income undiluted.
